title: Allow arbitrary size for the desktop icons and label
line: Desktop icon size and label width can now be set to any pixel value with two sliders in the desktop's Icons settings.
explanation: The desktop and Folder View settings only offered fixed steps: the icon size slider snapped to ten preset sizes and label width was a Narrow/Medium/Wide combo box, both stored as indexes. Two new settings, iconSizePixels and labelWidthPixels (0 = use the old preset index), now hold a size in pixels. The Icons page shows both as pixel sliders (22-256 px and 64-256 px) with a tooltip giving the exact value, the right-click Icon Size presets still work and clear the custom value, and the menu shows no preset checked when a custom size is in use.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: allow any icon size and label width

Icon size and label width could only be set in fixed steps. The icon
size and label width settings are now sliders in pixels that can take
any value, while the context menu keeps offering the preset sizes.

BUG: 518888
